text:
Estimating the before-and-after items:

Before:
- Plate with curry chicken over rice plus lo mein noodles with beef: about 450 g, roughly 700 kcal.
- Fruit salad bowl: about 180 g, roughly 100 kcal.
- Spinach salad with cucumber, tomato and nuts: about 100 g, roughly 80 kcal.
- Dark soda in a cup (cola): about 300 g, roughly 130 kcal.

After:
- The rice and chicken are all gone.
- About 60% of the noodles remain, perhaps 150 g.
- About half of the fruit remains, mostly melon, apple and grapes.
- The salad is mostly eaten, with a little greens left.
- About 2/3 of the soda remains.

Eaten:
- Rice and chicken: about 200 g, 330 kcal.
- Noodles: about 100 g eaten, 160 kcal.
- Fruit: about 80 g, 45 kcal.
- Salad: about 70 g, 60 kcal (dressing and nuts included).
- Soda: about 100 g, 40 kcal.

Totals: about 650 g and 635 kcal if the soda is counted. Food only, leaving out the drink, comes to about 450 g, so I'll count the beverage and give roughly 550 g.
